name: Koffee with Karan
description: Koffee with Karan is an Indian talk show hosted by filmmaker and television personality Karan Johar and produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, the digital content division of Johar's production company Dharma Productions

videos.title: Shahrukh Khan and Kajol
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Kajol and Shahrukh Khan to the show. The episode deals with articulate Kajol and philosophical Shahrukh. Kajol calls herself naturally stubborn, hot headed and with narrow frame of focus, while Shahrukh calls her a beautiful living legend. Kajol reveals that her husband, Ajay did not bother about her onscreen chemistry with Shahrukh. In the rapid fire round, both Kajol and Sharukh tickle the funny bones with their witty answers.

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor and Rani Mukherji
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts two glamorous actressess of bollywood, Kareena Kapoor and Rani Mukherji. The show starts off with a discussion, can two actresses become friends. Kareena states that Shahid Kapoor is a very special part of her life. In the rapid fire round, Rani tickles the questions with witty answers, while Kareena answers sensibly. In a survey among actors, Kareena gets more points in sex appeal and Rani wins as an actress.

videos.title: Preity Zinta and Saif Ali Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the bubbly, Preity Zinta and the dashing Saif Ali Khan. Karan starts off the show with the rumours related to Preity Zinta. He discusses about the rumour of Preity's affair with Saif. Karan, Preity and Saif discuss about a nasty bike accident of Saif on the sets.

videos.title: Aishwarya Rai and Sanjay Leela Bhansali
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the stunning Aishwarya Rai and one of the most successful film directors, Sanjay Leela Bhansali. The show goes on with a discussion about the bonding between Aishwarya and Sanjay including a period of misunderstanding between them.

videos.title: Fardeen Khan and Zayed Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar interviews Fardeen Khan and Zayed Khan. He discusses with Fardeen and Zayed Khan about a drug incident related to Fardeen. Zayed compliments Fardeen with a title, Lady Killer. Karan questions Zayed about the rumour on his affair with Esha Deol. Karan asks Zayed and Fardeen about how their fathers Sanjay Khan and Feroze Khan have influenced their lives.

videos.title: Gurinder Chadha and Farah Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts two extremely talented women film directors, Gurinder Chadha and Farah Khan. The show deals with the criticisms related to Gurinder and Farah's films. Karan discusses the controversies related to Farah and Gurinder. They suggest Karan a list of girls to marry, but he rejects all the suggestions. In the rapid fire round, Farah answers bravely, while Gurinder gives diplomatic answers.

videos.title: Amitabh Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the legend Amitabh Bachchan and his son Abhishek. The discussion starts with a talk about Abhishek's career as an actor. Karan questions about the rumours on Abhsihek's affairs. Karan asks the duo about Abhishek's broken engagement. In the rapid fire round both the legend and his son tickle the questions with witty answers. In a survey among bollywood actresses, Amitabh wins the contest 'Who is Sexier'.

videos.title: Gauri Khan and Suzanne Roshan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Gauri Khan and Suzzane Roshan. Suzzane reveals how Hrithik Roshan proposed to her. Karan questions Gauri and Suzzane about their inter caste marriage. Karan asks Gauri and Suzzane whether they feel insecure with the female co-stars of their husbands. Later on, Shahrukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan join their wives in the show.

videos.title: Bipasha Basu and Lara Dutta
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Bipasha Basu and Lara Dutta. Karan discusses about their affairs. Karan questions Lara and Bipasha about Amisha Patel's statements against them. Karan asks Lara and Bipasha's reactions when the male co-stars flirt with them.

videos.title: Ekta Kapoor and Sunita Menon
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Ekta Kapoor and the astrologer, Sunita Menon. Karan starts off the show with a talk on the common characteristics in him and Ekta. Show goes on with the discussion about Sunita's transformation. Ekta states that she will stick with "K" for her show titles. Karan asks Ekta about the criticisms related to her stories. In the rapid round, Ekta tickles the questions with witty answers, while Sunita answers sensibly.

videos.title: Sushmita Sen and Sanjay Dutt
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Miss Universe Sushmita Sen and Sanjay Dutt in his show. Karan starts the show asking Sushmita about the night when she won the Miss India contest. Karan asks Sanjay Dutt about the ups and downs in his life. Karan discusses with the star duo about their relationships. Sushmita and Sanjay talk about their spiritual beliefs.

videos.title: Hrithik Roshan and Farhan Akhtar
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Hrithik Roshan and Farhan Akhtar. Farhan and Hrithik share their childhood experiences. Karan discusses with Farhan about the criticisms related to him. Karan talks to Farhan and Hirthik about their fathers. The show goes through a discussion on the movie 'Lakshya'. In the rapid fire round, Hrithik answers sensibly, while Farhan gives witty answers. Later Uday Chopra joins his childhood friends and shares his experiences with Farhan and Hrithik.

videos.title: Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the Deol brothers, Sunny and Bobby. Karan starts the show with a talk about Sunny Deol's wild behavior in his childhood. Karan discusses the experiences of the two brothers. Karan asks Bobby about his discord with Kareena and Karisma Kapoor. Karan asks Sunny about the period when he went through financial problems.

videos.title: Shabana Azmi and Shobhaa De
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Shabana Azmi and Shobha Dey. Show starts with the discussion about Aishwarya Rai starring in Hollywood. Karan discusses with Shobha and Shabana about film journalism. Karan asks Shabana's reaction on criticisms. Karan discusses with Shabana and Shobha about the bollywood bias. In the rapid fire round, both answer very bravely.

videos.title: Abhishek Bachchan and Preity Zinta
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Abhishek Bachchan and Preity Zinta for the second time in the show. Karan questions Preity and Abhishek about their discord. Abhsihek calls Preity a very cool and honest person. Karan questions them about the criticisms they have received. Karan, Abhishek and Preity have a funny conversation. Karan finds it challenging to handle Preity and Abhishek. All three have fun in the rapid fire round with really funny answers.

videos.title: Konkona Sen Sharma and Rahul Bose
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes Konkana Sen Sharma and Rahul Bose to the show. Konkana speaks out her opinion on mainstream cinema, while Rahul talks about the formula which makes a movie a hit. Karan finds Konkana's ideas matching with that of Kajol's. In the rapid fire round, Konkana fumbles, whereas Rahul turns diplomatic.

videos.title: Priyanka Chopra and Arjun Rampal
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Miss World Priyanka Chopra and the model turned actor, Arjun Ramphal. Karan asks Arjun and Priyanka's take on casting couch in the industry. Karan discusses about the controversies related to Arjun and Priyanka. In the rapid fire round, Arjun gives committed answers while Priyanka answers diplomatically.

videos.title: Smriti Malhotra Irani and Sakshi Tanwar
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the two popular Indian Television actresses, Smriti Malhotra Irani and Sakshi Tanwar. In conversation with Karan, Smriti explains about the challenges she faces while doing her serials. She extends her gratitude to Balaji Tele Films and appreciates Ekta Kapoor's efficiency. Sakshi focuses on her conviction and conversation with Ekta Kapoor. She is concerned about the significance of characters and good roles.

videos.title: Vivek Oberoi and John Abraham
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the two popular Bollywood stars, Vivek Oberoi and John Abraham. Vivek admires Aishwarya Rai and Kunal for tremendously supporting him in his initial film career. Karan reminds him of his 2002 films. Vivek narrates about the complications he had with the media and menace against multi-starrer roles. John highlights on his role in the films and his passion for physical fitness.

videos.title: Malaika Arora Khan, Amrita Arora and Dino Morea
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts a popular model and dancer, Malaika Arora Khan and her sister, Amrita Arora as well as a super model, Dino Morea. In conversation with Karan, Malaika explains about her relationship with Arbaaz Khan and her family affairs. Amrita highlights on her sensuality and about her ex-boyfriend Osmaan. She admires Arbaaz's idealism. Dino emphasizes on his film and modelling career. He praises Malaika and Amrita's beauty.

videos.title: Rishi Kapoor and Neetu Singh
videos.overview: The popular actress and actor of seventies, Rishi Kapoor and Nitu Singh are welcomed by Karan Johar. Karan cherishes their presence and enthusiastically asks about their initial relationship. In conversation with Karan, Rishi and Nitu explain about their interaction with each other while shooting movies. Later, they both share their reminiscence of romance and about their post-married life.

videos.title: Esha Deol and Shahid Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the two popular Bollywood stars, Esha Deol and Shahid Kapoor. Esha says about her love and passion for acting. Karan admires the popularity of Dhoom movie and its hit song. Shahid shares his overwhelming feelings on getting good response from the public for his noted movie, Ishq Vishk. He aims at focusing on his work. Shahid loves his private life and admires Kareena's humility.

videos.title: Hema Malini and Zeenat Aman
videos.overview: The popular Bollywood actresses, Hema Malini and Zeenat Aman are welcomed by Karan Johar. Hema states about her interest in political affairs and passion for dancing. She admires Dharmendra's concentration on acting. Zeenat focuses on her family and explains about her son's talent. She pays priority to her family and believes in doing quality work. Also, she has signed a few Malayalam films.

videos.title: KWK S1 Special Episode - 1
videos.overview: Karan Johar presents his interesting conversations of the previous episodes with the varied eminent stars of Bollywood cinema. He focuses on the rapid fire round contest hosted by him with the popular actors and actresses, Amitabh Bacchan, Abhishek Bachchan, Nitu Singh, Rishi Kapoor, Hema Malini, Shahid Kapoor, Esha Deol, Vivek Oberoi, John Abraham, Malaika Arora Khan, Amrita Arora and Dino Morea.

videos.title: KWK S1 Special Episode - 2
videos.overview: Shahrukh Khan welcomes Amitabh Bachchan on the show. He pays his dedication to him for being his greatest source of inspiration and motivating him in Hindi Cinema. Amitabh appreciates Shahrukh's spirit and focus on film concepts and camera. Later, Karan hosts the show and welcomes Sanjay Leela Bhansali. Sanjay narrates about his noted films, Dev Das and Black. In the rapid fire round, Karan invites the judges, Farah Khan and Farhan Akhtar.

videos.title: Kajol & Rani Mukherji
videos.overview: Karan hosts the two popular actresses of Bollywood, Kajol and Rani Mukherjee. Kajol narrates about her films, Kabhi Alvida Na Kehna and Fanaa. During their conversation with Karan, Kajol and Rani heartily compliment each other. Rani has been influenced by Amir Khan and Shahrukh Khan. Later, Karan hosts Shahrukh Khan in his show. Shahrukh shares his marvelous experiences with Kajol and Rani Mukherjee. He praises both of them.

videos.title: Hrithik Roshan & Priyanka Chopra
videos.overview: Karan welcomes the noted stars of Bollywood to his show, Hrithik Roshan and Priyanka Chopra. In conversation with Karan, Hrithik emphasizes on his popular films, Krish and Dhoom. He pays his rich dedication to his father Rakesh Roshan for his contribution to the film's success. He takes his privilege in exploring the creative movies, and praises the beauty and diligence of Priyanka Chopra.

videos.title: Mallika Sherawat & Sanjay Leela Bhansali
videos.overview: Karan Johar invites Mallika Sherawat and Sanjay Leela Bhansali. Mallika narrates about her initial film career and popularity of her hit movie, Murder. She is more concerned about script issues and speaks about her liberating relationship with Mahesh Bhatt. She pays her concentration on professionalism rather than having social interaction. Sanjay compliments on Mallika's sensuality and her glamour.

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor & Shahid Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes Kareena Kapoor and Shahid Kapoor to his show. In her conversation with Karan, Kareena highlights on her tremendous role in the film, Omkara. She believes in her talent and explores for the big projects. She admires Shahrukh Khan and is positively influenced by Shahid Kapoor. Shahid praises Kareena's loyalty and her potentiality in her life. At the end, Karan hosts Karisma Kapoor for judging the rapid fire round.

videos.title: Saif Ali Khan & Soha Ali Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Saif Ali Khan and Soha Ali Khan. In his conversation with Karan, Saif narrates about his professional and personal aspects of life. Pertaining to his marital affair, he pays his respect to his ex-wife Amrita Singh and states about his relationship with an Italian girl, Roza. Karan speaks about Soha's emotional role in the film, Rang De Basanti. Soha takes pride in Saif's achievements.

videos.title: Mira Nair & Tabu
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the renowned film maker Mira Nair and actress Tabu. Tabu explains to Karan about her personal constraints in perspective with movies and lacks confidence in judging her own skill. Mira Nair appreciates Tabu's efficient roles in her movies. Mira believes in making creative films based on the sensibility and exquisite features. Karan reminds Mira of her noted movie Monsoon Wedding. He also hosts Farah Khan in the Coffee Hamper round.

videos.title: Sanjay Dutt & Priya Dutt
videos.overview: Noted film actors, Sanjay Dutt and Priya Dutt, are welcomed by Karan Johar in the show. Karan introduces Sanjay as one of the most emerging and lovable personalities in the film world. In his conversation with Karan, Sanjay shares about his grief of the past. He trusts in ameliorating and learning for the future prospects. Priya is inspired by Sunil Dutt's ideality and has been ever supportive to Sanjay.

videos.title: Dr. Vijay Mallya & Shobhaa De
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the popular Industrialist, Dr. Vijay Mallya and the noted author, Shobhaa De. Dr. Mallya takes pride in holding his transparent personality and being a brand ambassador of his brands. He extends his views on the political affairs and evolution of projects. He admires a parliamentarian for complimenting his Kingfisher airlines. Shobhaa emphasizes on the facets of journalism and the changing channels of the media.

videos.title: Konkona Sen Sharma, Kunal Kapoor & Ritesh Deshmukh
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Konkona Sen Sharma, Kunal Kapoor and Ritesh Deshmukh. In discussion with Karan, Konkona speaks about her leading role pertaining to the song and dance item in a movie. She admires Jaya Bachchan as an amazing person and discusses about the regional movies. Karan appreciates Kunal Kapoor's role in film, Rang De Basanti. Kunal expresses about his confidence level and personal strategies. Ritesh presents anecdote of his movies.

videos.title: Hema Malini & Jaya Bachchan
videos.overview: Karan Johar invites the noted actresses of yesteryears, Hema Malini and Jaya Bachchan. Karan takes pride in Jaya's significant roles for boosting her family spirit. Jaya states about her encouragement to Abhishek Bachchan during his struggles in the movies. Hema Malini shares her personal experiences and interest in the political affairs and Hindi cinema. Later, Karan welcomes Shweta Bachchan and Esha Deol and discusses about their family anecdotes.

videos.title: Rakesh Roshan, Rakesh Mehra, Kunal Kohli & Raju Hirani
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the eminent film directors, Rakesh Roshan, Rakesh Mehra, Kunal Kohli and Raju Irani. Karan admires Rakesh Roshan's creativity in his noted films, Koi Mil Gaya and Krish. Mr. Roshan highlights on his film's production and creativity. Karan admires Rakesh Mehra's film Rang De Basanti for awaking the generation and extends his compliments to Raju Irani's movie Lage Raho Munna Bhai and Kunal's Fanaa.

videos.title: Rakhi Sawant
videos.overview: Karan hosts Rakhi Sawant in his show. In her conversation with Karan, Rakhi anguishes her family impediments pertaining to the controversy with her parents. However, she is motivated by the public's support for her reality show. In the rapid fire round, Rakhi thoughtfully reciprocates the public's queries. Later, Karan hosts Carol Gracias and Rahul Roy. Both Carol and Rahul admire Rakhi's gesture and cherish the show.

videos.title: Bipasha Basu & John Abraham
videos.overview: Karan hosts the leading Bollywood stars, Bipasha Basu and John Abraham. Discussing with Karan, Bipasha tells about her achievements and passion for creative roles. Karan reminds her of the popular film, Dhoom 2. John shares his past experiences when he had to strive for his career. He aims to fulfill his achievements and pays his rich dedication to the audience. He wants to be perceived as a creative actor.

videos.title: Rishi Kapoor, Randhir Kapoor & Chimpu Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan hosts the noted film stars, Rishi Kapoor, Randhir Kapoor and Chimpu Kapoor. In their conversation with Karan, Rishi and Randhir share about their family anecdote. Rishi states about the past and present scenario of Hindi cinema. Randhir reminds Karan of his fraternity among the family members. He pays his rich tribute to Raj Kapoor. In the rapid fire round, Karan invites Neetu Singh to judge the contest. Finally, Karan hosts Reema Kapoor on the show.

videos.title: Richard Gere
videos.overview: Karan Johar invites Hollywood superstar, Richard Gere. In his conversation with Karan, Richard praises the humanitarian environment of Hollywood industry. He emphasizes on conducting campaigns for AIDS awareness and his consistent involvement in supporting the events. Also, he appreciates Shabana Azmi and Bipasha Basu's prominent roles in this aspect. Richard pays his gratitude to Bollywood stars and rejoices his interaction with them. He feels pride in getting an honor for Koffee Hamper round.

videos.title: Ektaa Kapoor, Ronit Roy, Ram Kapoor & Hiten Tejwani
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Indian television and film producer Ektaa Kapoor and some of the noted television stars, Ronit Roy, Ram Kapoor and Hiten Tejwani on the show. Ektaa discusses with Karan about her fascination for Hollywood shows and she intends to revamp the television serials. Ronit, Ram and Hiten pay their gratitude to Ektaa for resurrecting their career and her commitment to the work.

videos.title: Shilpa Shetty & Shamita Shetty
videos.overview: Karan invites Shilpa Shetty and Shamita Shetty to the show. In her conversation with Karan, Shilpa shares her experiences about the Big Brother International show on television. She expresses her disappointment with regard to the media. Karan admires her repertoire of films, Dhadkan and Phir Milenge. Shilpa is elated to get good reviews from UK public. Shamita takes pride in Shilpa's achievements. At the end, Karan welcomes Shilpa's mother Sunanda Shetty.

videos.title: Preity Zinta & Bobby Deol
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Preity Zinta and Bobby Deol on the show. In her conversation with Karan, Preity shares her personal relationship with Bollywood legendaries and expresses her annoyance with the media. She shares her enchanting moments with Rani Mukherjee. Karan reminds Bobby and Preity of their noted movies, Soldier and Jhoom Barabar Jhoom. Bobby narrates about his film career and some anecdote of the film shootings.

videos.title: Madhuri Dixit
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes an eminent actress of ninety eras, Madhuri Dixit. In her conversation with Karan, she extends her views on the changing scenario of the film industry and shares her adventurous moments of romantic days. She feels elated to come back in the Bollywood industry after six years and shares her immortal moments of Denmark. Finally, she receives honor from her ardent fans.

videos.title: Anil Kapoor & Akshaye Khanna
videos.overview: Karan Johar invites Anil Kapoor and Akshaye Khanna to the show. In his discussion with Karan, Anil states that he has been in the film industry since 1978. He pays his rich tribute to Yash Johar and thanks the Almighty for being kind with him. He extends his gratitude to the entire film industry and his family for tremendously supporting him in his film career. Akshaye appreciates the multifarious environment and privileges of Bollywood industry.

videos.title: Himesh Reshammiya
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts composer and singer, Himesh Reshammiya on the show. In his conversation with Karan, Himesh speaks about the contradictory aspects of his musical perspective and about his leading role in the non-conventional films. He thanks god, public and his destiny for bestowing grand success in his career. He pays his reverence to his mother and gets touched by his fans' compliments for him.

videos.title: Lara Dutta & Katrina Kaif
videos.overview: Former Miss Universe Lara Dutta and the glamorous actress, Katrina Kaif, are welcomed by Karan Johar on the show. In her conversation with Karan, Lara highlights on glamorous perspective and about the modeling world. She takes pride in achieving grand success in the movie, Jhoom. Katrina praises Salman Khan's confidence and is elated to work with him. She discusses about the language and dialogues based on the film's situation.

videos.title: Javed Akhtar & Shabana Azmi
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts lyricist, Javed Akhtar, and actress, Shabana Azmi. In their conversation with Karan, Shabana and Mr. Javed share about their mutual relationship and maintaining an ideal situation in their journey of life. Javed lays emphasis on his relationship with producers and composers with respect to his script and lyrics depiction. He reminds Karan of his noted movies, Silsila and Saath Saath. Finally, Karan hosts Farhan Akhtar on the show.

videos.title: Farah Khan & Shahrukh Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the eminent choreographer, Farah Khan, and actor Shahrukh Khan on his show. Farah shares her interest in homemaking apart from choreography direction. Further, in his conversation with Karan, Shahrukh states about his concern for physical fitness and looks. He praises Farah's efficiency in choreography. Karan shows some clips of the film Om Shanti Om. At the end, Karan hosts Deepika Padukone on the show.

videos.title: KWK S2 Special Episode
videos.overview: The episode is based on the flashback of the show with respect to Karan Johar's conversations with the renowned film stars of Bollywood, industrialists and politicians. Karan highlights on the theme of the show and behind the scene. It's praiseworthy of Karan's painstaking efforts in conducting and implementing this creative show. Also, Karan pays his soulful gratitude to all his guests whom he hosts on the show and highlights their feedbacks on his popular show.

videos.title: Koffee Awards
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Rohit Bal, Malaika Arora and actor Cyrus Broacha as jury to announce the Koffe awards 2007, based on the list of nominations. The most glamorous female of Koffee Award goes to Priyanka Chopra and for male goes to Hrithik Roshan. The best supporting appearance goes to Karisma Kapoor. The best debut male goes to Himesh Reshammiya and female to Mira Nair. The best rapid fire female is Kareena Kapoor and male is Shahrukh Khan.

videos.title: Abhishek Bachchan & Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Miss World Pageant, Aishwarya Rai, and actor Abhishek Bachchan on the show. In her conversation with Karan, Aishwarya states about the correlation of marriage with the career. She is of opinion that one can handle career by simultaneously maintaining a good marital relationship. Abhishek Bachchan puts his views on his interaction with the co-stars of the film industry and discusses about his personal thoughts.

videos.title: Ranbir Kapoor & Imran Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the actors Ranbir Kapoor and Imran Khan on the show. Ranbir praises Katrina Kaif and Deepika Padukone for being best friends. He takes pride in being the most educative person in the Kapoor's family. In respect to his film career and its insecurity, he is much conscious. Imran states about his confidence level and his firm belief in doing the right job. He appreciates Ranbir's caliber and plans to produce a film with him.

videos.title: Deepika Padukone & Sonam Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the popular actresses of Bollywood, Deepika Padukone and Sonam Kapoor, on the show. In her conversation with Karan, Deepika states about Ranbir Kapoor and reminiscences her friendly relation with him for two years. Sonam pays her compliment to Ranbir Kapoor.

videos.title: Farah Khan, Rajkumar Hirani & Imtiaz Ali
videos.overview: Choreographer Farah Khan and directors, Rajkumar Hirani and Imtiaz Ali, are welcomed by Karan Johar on the show. Karan admires Farah's efficiency in maintaining her professional and domestic life perfectly. Farah expresses her pleasure in having consistent interaction with Shahrukh Khan, despite of being busy with her choreography. Imtiaz shares his pleasure in making his film, Socha Na Tha. Raju states about his meeting with Vinod Chopra.

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor & Saif Ali Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts actress Kareena Kapoor and actor Saif Ali Khan on the show. Karan praises Kareena for attaining a top position in the film industry. In her conversation with Karan, Kareena admires Priyanka Chopra's fantastic acting and is an ardent fan of her. Saif and Kareena discuss about the family and marital affair. Saif appreciates Kareena's passion and dedication in acting perspective.

videos.title: Anil Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt & Kangana Ranaut
videos.overview: The noted film stars of Bollywood, Anil Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt and Kangna Ranaut, are welcomed by Karan Johar on the show. In his conversation with Karan, Sanjay reminds Anil Kapoor of Jackie Shroff's acting in most of his films. Karan is surprised to know about Sanjay Dutt and Anil Kapoor's least combination in the movies. Sanjay reminisces about his daughter and talks about Madhuri Dixit. Anil pays his gratitude to Madhuri Dixit. Kangna shares her film experiences.

videos.title: Shahid Kapoor & Priyanka Chopra
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts glamorous actress Priyanka Chopra and actor Shahid Kapoor on the show. Priyanka discusses with Karan about her dedication in improvising her acting skill and starting her successful film career. Karan enthusiastically asks Shahid and Priyanka about their dating. They share their experiences of film Kaminey. Priyanka appreciates Kareena's fraternity for her.

videos.title: Amitabh Bachchan & Shweta Nanda
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the superstar, Amitabh Bachchan and Shweta Bachchan on the show. Karan pays honor to Amitabh for his marvelous achievements in the film industry and huge popularity of his television shows. In his conversation with Karan, Amitabh states about healthy rivalry among stardoms during his initial film career and emphasizes on merits and demerits of the media. Shweta shares her childhood experience when she learnt about Amitabh's injury.

videos.title: Shahrukh Khan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the legendary Indian film actor, Shahrukh Khan. Shahrukh reveals his new resolution to lead a baggage free life. He talks about the controversy surrounding him and his fellow actors, Salman Khan and Aamir Khan. He also talks about his marriage and his friends in the film industry. After an entertaining rapid fire round, Shahrukh gives an emotional thank you speech to Karan.

videos.title: Rani Mukerji & Vidya Balan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the talented Indian actresses, Rani Mukherjee and Vidya Balan. The duo talks about their upcoming film, No One Killed Jessica. Rani and Vidya talk about their ups and downs in the film industry, their directors, on screen chemistry with their co-stars and their personal life. The television actresses express their love for the duo.

videos.title: Lara Dutta & Mahesh Bhupathi
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts Miss Universe Lara Dutta and professional tennis player Mahesh Bhupathi. The duo talks about their profession, their intriguing love story and their upcoming nuptial. Mahesh reveals that he is an avid fan of Govinda and David Dhawan films. Lara and Mahesh talk about their production houses, Big Daddy and Bheegi Basanti.

videos.title: Hrithik Roshan & Suzanne Roshan
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the superstar Hrithik Roshan and his wife Suzanne Roshan. The duo talks about their marriage, kids and profession. Hrithik talks about his critically acclaimed performance in the film Guzaarish. He addresses the controversy revolving around his film and actor Salman Khan. Hrithik's fans in the film industry express their views.

videos.title: Ajay Devgn
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the talented Bollywood actor, Ajay Devgn. Ajay expresses his views on award shows. He talks about his marriage to actress Kajol, his daughter, the commercial success of his films and his co-stars, Kareena Kapoor, Abhishek Bachchan and Sanjay Dutt. After an entertaining rapid fire round, Ajay's fans express their love for his acting.

videos.title: KWK S3 Special Episode
videos.overview: Karan Johar showcases the best of Koffee with Karan, season 3. He replays the controversies revolving around Shahrukh Khan and Salman Khan, Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone, Kareena Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra. He reveals the celebrity link ups and their juicy secrets. He reveals the best of the rapid fire round. The episode ends with Shahrukh's emotional speech.

videos.title: Sajid Khan, Ritesh Deshmukh, Boman Irani
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts actors Ritesh Deshmukh, Boman Irani and film maker Sajid Khan. Sajid talks about his history with film director Ashutosh Gowariker. Ritesh and Boman talk about their debut in Bollywood. The funny trio reveals their expertise as Indian movie buffs and their chemistry on stage hosting award shows.

videos.title: Anushka Sharma, Ranveer Singh
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the debut actors Ranvir Singh and Anushka Sharma from the film, Band Baaja Baaraat. The duo talks about their onscreen chemistry and love life. Ranvir and Anushka talk about their successful debut in the Bollywood industry. The fans choose between team Ranvir and team Anushka.

videos.title: Madhuri Dixit, Sonakshi Sinha
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the iconic Indian actress Madhuri Dixit and the debut actress Sonakshi Sinha. Madhuri talks about her personal life and her professional life. Sonakshi talks about her film Dabangg with Salman Khan and her personal fight with obesity. Madhuri's fans express their love for her dance.

videos.title: John Abraham
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts super model turned actor, John Abraham. John expresses his feelings on being an icon for the homosexual community in India. He talks about his love life, his bachelor pad and the commercial success of his films. He talks about his chemistry with his female co-stars, Sonam Kapoor, Katrina Kaif and Deepika Padukone. John answers fan questions.

videos.title: Farhan Akhtar, Zoya Akhtar
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the talented Indian film directors, Zoya Akhtar and Farhan Akhtar. The duo talks about their journey in the Indian film industry, their childhood and their celebrity family. Zoya talks about her upcoming film, Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara with Farhan Akhtar, Abhay Deol, Katrina Kaif and Hrithik Roshan. An aspiring Indian music band performs for Farhan.

videos.title: Ekta Kapoor, Tushar Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan Johar hosts the queen of Indian television, Ekta Kapoor and actor Tusshar Kapoor. The duo talks about their sibling rivalry, the casting couch in the television and the movie industry. Ekta claims that Tusshar had signed on to do her movies when no actor wanted to do them. She talks about her upcoming films, Ragini MMS and The Dirty Picture. He promotes his movie, Shor in the City.

videos.title: Best of KWK Season 3
videos.overview: Karan Johar showcases the best of Koffee with Karan, season 3. Take a look at the best debut by the energetic young actors Sonam Kapoor, Anushka Sharma, Ranvir Singh, Imran Khan and Sonakshi Sinha. Love is in the air for Priyanka Chopra and Shahid Kapoor. Karan replays some of the highlights of the show, the controversy between Deepika Padukone and Ranbir Kapoor and emotional speech by Shahrukh Khan. He reveals the best of the rapid fire round and the contents of the coveted Koffee hamper.

videos.title: Koffee Awards 2011
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes the judges of the Koffee award 2011, Rajeev Masand, Manish Malhotra, Koel Purie and Sarita Tanwar. Kareena Kapoor and Hrithik Roshan win the best dressed Koffee awards. Ranbir Kapoor and Sonam Kapoor win the best debut award. Shahrukh Khan and Deepika Padukone win the best performance award. Kareena Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan win the best rapid fire award. Sonam Kapoor and Deepika Padukone win the best episode award.

videos.title: Salman Khan
videos.overview: Salman Khan opens season 4 of Koffee With Karan like an entertainer! If you missed the episode on television, fret not, we've got it right here! Sure to keep you hooked as Salman spills the beans! Also his father, Salim makes a guest appearance!

videos.title: Ranbir Kapoor & Kareena Kapoor Khan
videos.overview: It's the Kapoors on Koffee With Karan S4! Karan brings the cousins, Ranbir Kapoor and Kareena Kapoor together for the very first time. If you missed the episode on television, fret not, we've got it right here! Sure to keep you hooked as Ranbir speaks about Katrina! Kareena speaks about some "rumours" about Ranbir that never made it in the media!

videos.title: Aamir Khan & Kiran Rao
videos.overview: For the very first time on Koffee with Karan, Aamir Khan makes an appearance with Kiran Rao. Sure to keep you hooked as Aamir Khan and Kiran Rao play Karan Johar's quiz.

videos.title: Ranveer Singh & Arjun Kapoor
videos.overview: Arjun Kapoor makes his first appearance for the show as they promote their upcoming movie Gunday. Shanoo Sharma accompanies the stars in this episode and speaks about Ranveer's entry into films.

videos.title: Sidharth Malhotra, Alia Bhatt & Varun Dhawan
videos.overview: The Student of the Year lead actors Sidharth Malhotra, Alia Bhatt and Varun Dhawan are the celebrities appearing in this episode. The trio speak about their personal relationships and interesting facts about their professional experiences.

videos.title: Priyanka Chopra & Deepika Padukone
videos.overview: Deepika Padukone believes it is only a perception that people in Bollywood cannot stay friends. She clarifies her statement made on the 'Ranbir-Kat' Ibiza vacation! Karan enquirers Priyanka and Deepika about their lesbian encounters, if any.

videos.title: Farhan Akhtar & Vidya Balan
videos.overview: Singer, director and actor Farhan Akhtar makes an appearance alongside the super talented Vidya Balan. Karan congratulates Farhan for his performance in Bhaag Milkha Bhaag. While Farhan shares his experiences on sets of Bhaag Milkha Bhaag, Vidya Balan is least bothered about the criticism she faces for her fashion sense.

videos.title: Akshay Kumar
videos.overview: It's the Mega Movie Star, Akshay Kumar with KJo! Akshay speaks about the straight forward nature of his lovely wife. Karan admits that the only woman he fell in love with was Tina. The tables have turned! It's Karan Johar on the grill, this time! Akshay Kumar throws some rapid fire questions at Karan Johar.

videos.title: Emraan Hashmi & Mahesh Bhatt
videos.overview: Karan welcomes Emraan Hashmi and Mahesh Bhatt on the sets of Koffee. Mahesh takes credit in crafting Emraan's persona and states that he has the complete right to ask for a repayment. Emraan then reveals his bizarre way of repaying him.

videos.title: Shahid Kapoor & Sonakshi Sinha
videos.overview: Karan welcomes Shahid Kapoor and Sonakshi Sinha on Koffee With Karan Season 4. Shahid Kapoor feels relieved without a girl friend. He is happy as his recent movie, R... Rajkumar, is a hit. The sizzling duo shares their unique experiences in the film industry and open up about their personal lives in this special episode.

videos.title: Anushka Sharma & Anurag Kashyap
videos.overview: Indian film director Anurag Kashyap is here for the very first time on Koffee With Karan, with the gorgeous Anushka Sharma! Karan enquires Anushka about Virat Kohli. He speaks to Anurag about the genre of films that he makes. Anurag opens up about his alleged 'feud' and his controversial comments about Karan's movies.

videos.title: Abhishek Bachchan & Farah Khan
videos.overview: Fun-loving Abhishek Bachchan and multi-talented Farah Khan are welcomed on the show by Karan. Ranveer Singh's hot body is the topic of discussion between the trio - Abhishek Bachchan, Farah Khan & Karan Johar! Watch Abhishek and Farah's hilarious remarks on Ranveer's body in this quirky episode. Abhishek's pranks are sure to keep you hooked to your couches!

videos.title: Madhuri Dixit & Juhi Chawla
videos.overview: Yesteryear's top actresses, Juhi Chawla and Madhuri Dixit have always been in the news for their rivalry and animosity! Get to know from the actresses themselves that how much of camaraderie or enmity they share. The two of them have always been pitted against each other for their acting skills. This time, they compete against each other for Karan's Koffee Hamper. Let's see who wins!

videos.title: Nargis Fakhri & Freida Pinto
videos.overview: Nargis Fakhri and Freida Pinto sizzle the Koffee couch on this special episode. Karan teases Nargis about her relationship with Uday Chopra and enquires Freida about her music video with Bruno Mars. Later, Nargis and Freida come up with some bold responses to Karan's rapid fire questions.

videos.title: Aditya Roy Kapur & Shraddha Kapoor
videos.overview: Ashiqui 2 stars Aditya Roy Kapur and Shraddha Kapoor make their Koffee debut in this episode. The duo share their experience on the sets of the blockbuster hit. Later, Aditya admits to his relationship with Ranbir Kapoor! But he also says that Shraddha and he are very much in love.

videos.title: Kajol & Ayan Mukherjee
videos.overview: Karan welcomes cousins Kajol and Ayan Mukherji on the show. Karan takes the credit of mentoring Ayan, who admits to his friendship with Ranbir Kapoor. Ayan and Kajol then come up with some very intelligent answers to the rapid fire questions.

videos.title: Rohit Shetty & Zoya Akhtar
videos.overview: Karan invites Zoya Akhtar & Rohit Shetty, two filmmakers with diverse perspectives, on the show. Zoya's Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara seems to be one of Rohit's favourite movies. The three filmmakers discuss about their profession. Zoya and Rohit have come all dressed up to the show for a very specific reason. Watch to find out what the reason is.

videos.title: Anil Kapoor & Sonam Kapoor
videos.overview: Karan Johar is in conversation with the glamorous father-daughter duo, Anil and Sonam Kapoor. Arjun Kapoor shares a few interesting facts about Sonam and Anil. Later, Anil reveals his daughter's wish to enter politics. Watch to find out what Fashionista Sonam Kapoor has to say about it.

videos.title: Parineeti Chopra & Alia Bhatt
videos.overview: Alia Bhatt and Parineeti Chopra feature on this episode of Koffee with Karan. It is Alia's second appearance this season, and Parineeti's debut on the show. The newbie actresses of Bollywood who are doing a good job on the acting front, are seen sharing a friendly vibe on the show. Mahesh Bhatt and Priyanka Chopra share a few interesting facts about Alia and Parineeti.

videos.title: Best of Koffee With Karan Season 4
videos.overview: Karan Johar welcomes you to the last episode of Koffee With Karan - Season 4. Koffee With Karan Season 4 brought out the best in the actors of B-Town! Watch some of the best moments that you cannot miss!

videos.title: Shahrukh Khan & Alia Bhatt
videos.overview: In the first episode of the season, it's Shah Rukh Khan and Alia Bhatt's turn on the couch. Karan probes Alia about her personal life and sharing the screen with King Khan, while Shah Rukh talks about being a protective father and competition with himself.

videos.title: Akshay Kumar & Twinkle Khanna
videos.overview: It's Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna's turn on the couch. Twinkle elaborates on how her life has changed post her marriage with Akshay. Later, Akshay surprises Twinkle by singing their favourite song.

videos.title: Arjun Kapoor & Varun Dhawan
videos.overview: It's Varun Dhawan and Arjun Kapoor on the couch this time around. The 'brothers from different mothers' get candid even as KJo puts them through fun tasks! So who will win that hamper and who will give out the secrets?

videos.title: Ranbir Kapoor & Ranveer Singh
videos.overview: This time around, it is Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor's turn on the couch. Ranbir and Ranveer's bromance is the high point of the episode and their quirky answers will have everyone talking. Karan Johar asks Ranbir about his newly single status while Ranveer Singh is unstoppable with his zany side.

videos.title: Aditya Roy Kapur & Parineeti Chopra
videos.overview: This week, it's time for Parineeti Chopra and Aditya Roy Kapur on the couch. While Parineeti gets candid about her rumoured relationships, watch what Aditya has to say about his on and off-screen chemistry with Parineeti.

videos.title: Salman Khan, Arbaaz Khan & Sohail Khan
videos.overview: It’s the 100th episode of Koffee With Karan and who better than Salman Khan to celebrate it with! Salman and his brothers, Arbaaz and Sohail, are on the couch today steaming it up with Karan Johar. From their underwear to their girlfriends, you have all the stories here!

videos.title: Aamir Khan, Fatima Shaikh & Sanya Malhotra
videos.overview: This time, it's Aamir Khan, Fatima Sana Shaikh and Sanya Malhotra's turn on the couch. Watch the reel life father-daughter trio sharing a great camaraderie and the candid rapid fire that follows.

videos.title: Anushka Sharma & Katrina Kaif
videos.overview: This time around, Anushka Sharma and Katrina Kaif turn on the heat. Watch them gang up against KJo and talk about the ‘I Hate Katrina’ club among other fun things.

videos.title: Shahid Kapoor & Mira Rajput
videos.overview: This week, it's Shahid Kapoor and his lovely wife, Mira on the couch. Pillow fights, inside secrets and ex-flames, the young couple discuss it all!

videos.title: Sidharth Malhotra & Jacqueline Fernandez
videos.overview: This week, it's Sidharth Malhotra and Jacqueline Fernandez's turn on the couch. While Jacqueline is all giggles in this episode, Sidharth has some bold answers for Karan's questions.

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor & Sonam Kapoor
videos.overview: This week Kareena Kapoor Khan and Sonam Kapoor get chatty. From why Sonam won’t ever date Ranbir Kapoor to their opinion on Deepika and Priyanka’s Hollywood splash, the Kapoor women say it all!

videos.title: Priyanka Chopra
videos.overview: It’s our desi-girl-gone-global on the couch this week. Priyanka Chopra rocks the couch as she talks about her Hollywood hungama, boys hitting on her and more! Some dirty secrets tumble out too of her open closet!

videos.title: Jackie Shroff & Tiger Shroff
videos.overview: This week, it's father-son duo Jackie Shroff and Tiger's turn on the couch. While Tiger is quiet, shy and guarded, Jackie is quite open about his views. Calling Madhuri Dixit a sexy siren, Jackie also talks about the female attention he has enjoyed over the years.

videos.title: Farah Khan & Sania Mirza
videos.overview: This week, it's Farah Khan and Sania Mirza's turn on the couch. While Sania admits that she is a Bollywood person, Farah enquires Karan about his sex life. In the rapid fire round, Sania joins hand with Farah to pull Karan's leg.

videos.title: Varun Dhawan & Alia Bhatt
videos.overview: This week, Alia Bhatt and Varun Dhawan are back on the koffee couch. From Varun sitting on Alia's lap to Alia feeling embarrassed when her relationship status is revealed, KJo can't seem to have control over his two 'students'.

videos.title: Saif Ali Khan & Kangana Ranaut
videos.overview: From Kangana Ranaut taking jibes at KJo to Saif Ali Khan taking a Koffee shot for ‘cheating on his partner’, this episode of Koffee With Karan promises to be at its candid best!

videos.title: Director's Special: Zoya Akhtar, Kabir Khan & Imtiaz Ali
videos.overview: This week, it's filmmakers Zoya Akhtar, Imtiaz Ali and Kabir Khan's turn to talk about the good, the bad and the ugly sides of Bollywood.

videos.title: Kapil Sharma
videos.overview: So the much-awaited episode of Koffee With Karan is here with Comedy King, Kapil Sharma. While he brings the couch down with his limited angrezi, Kapil makes KJo talk in Hindi!

videos.title: The Koffee Awards
videos.overview: In the finale, Neha Dhupia, Rohan Joshi, Malaika Arora and Ayan Mukerji form the panel that picks the best of season 5. Who are the recipients of the prestigious Koffee Awards?

videos.title: Best Of Season 5
videos.overview: KJo shows exerpts from #Koffeeturntable, fiery moments from the Rapid Fire and much more as the curtain falls on this season. Also, know the contents of the coveted KoffeeHamper!

videos.title: Deepika Padukone & Alia Bhatt
videos.overview: Alia Bhatt and Deepika Padukone grace the couch in the season opener and discuss their beaus, spill some beans and talk about their guilty pleasures.

videos.title: Ranveer Singh & Akshay Kumar
videos.overview: It's the desi boys, Akshay Kumar and Ranveer Singh's turn on the couch. The dynamic duo has a blast while sharing amazing stories and talking about their common interests, before facing the most-awaited Rapid Fire round.

videos.title: Aamir Khan
videos.overview: From sharing his take on the #MeToo movement to taking Koffee shots with Karan, Aamir Khan shows us how it's done. Then, Karan takes part in the Rapid Fire round alongside Aamir, judged by Malaika Arora.

videos.title: Varun Dhawan & Katrina Kaif
videos.overview: From spilling the beans on their relationships to talking about their experience of working together, bombshell Katrina Kaif and heartthrob Varun Dhawan heat up the Koffee like never before.

videos.title: Saif Ali Khan & Sara Ali Khan
videos.overview: It is a complete royal affair with Saif and Sara Ali Khan on the couch. From Sara spilling beans on her equation with Kareena Kapoor Khan to the nail-biting rapid fire round, it is nothing short of a roller coaster ride.

videos.title: Arjun Kapoor & Janhvi Kapoor
videos.overview: It's time for the star siblings Arjun and Janhvi Kapoor to take over the Koffee couch. While Arjun admits that he isn't single anymore, Janhvi tackles the question about her rumored relationship with Ishan Khattar.

videos.title: Kajol & Ajay Devgn
videos.overview: They are as different as chalk and cheese yet Ajay Devgn and Kajol are the industry's most ideal couple. They talk about balancing work and family besides sharing a great equation with their children.

videos.title: Badshah & Diljit Dosanjh
videos.overview: While the Badshah makes some naughty confessions, desi superstar Diljit Dosanjh leaves Karan in splits.

videos.title: Ayushmann Khurrana & Vicky Kaushal
videos.overview: Ayushmann Khurrana and Vicky Kaushal share the couch, speaking about their career graph and reveal their celebrity crushes. That's not all. Both show off their best acting skills too.

videos.title: Prabhas, S. S. Rajamouli & Rana Daggubati
videos.overview: The Baahubali trio Prabhas, Rana Daggubati and SS Rajamouli make a grand debut on the couch. From their relationship status to Prabhas and Rana's 'bad boy' label, Karan Johar digs deeper over a cup of koffee.

videos.title: Sonam Kapoor, Rhea Kapoor & Harshvardhan Kapoor
videos.overview: Sonam, Rhea, and Harshvardhan Kapoor grace the couch this week. Sonam speaks about her upcoming movie, Rhea reveals some quirky things about Sonam and Harshvardhan.

videos.title: K L Rahul & Hardik Pandya
videos.overview: Karan Johar sets the stage for K. L. Rahul and Hardik Pandya spill out their most coveted secrets and faces Karan's googlies in the rapid fire round.

videos.title: Shahid Kapoor & Ishaan Khattar
videos.overview: While Shahid prompts a tongue-tied Ishaan to spill the beans about his flings, KJo spins a naughty trap for the heart-throb brothers with his tricky rapid-fire artillery.

videos.title: Abhishek Bachchan & Shweta Nanda
videos.overview: Witness a night of quirky revelations and inside family jokes as the Bachchan siblings, Abhishek and Shweta, grab a spot on Karan Johar's 'Hot Seat'.

videos.title: Rajkummar Rao & Bhumi Pednekar
videos.overview: From Bhumi Pednekar's 'Toilet Wali Bhumi' revelation to Rajkumar Rao's #KaranPleeeej moment, the talented actors get candid on the Koffee Couch.

videos.title: Aditya Roy Kapur & Sidharth Malhotra
videos.overview: KJo brews a handsome cup of coffee as Aditya Roy Kapur talks about his 'social bee at the gym' title while Sidharth Malhotra reveals a story about his secret date and the missing curtains.

videos.title: Kriti Sanon & Kartik Aaryan
videos.overview: Kartik seems to be #LukaChupping when Kjo confronts him about his triangulated love life while Kriti makes some hilarious revelations. Don't miss out on Kartik's celebrated monologue followed by Kriti's riveting rapid-fire performance.

videos.title: Tiger Shroff, Ananya Pandey & Tara Sutaria
videos.overview: Tara Sutaria and Ananya Pandey add dollops of sass to their cute factor, while the quick-witted Tiger Shroff reveals his quirky side on the Koffee couch. Catch the trio in action as KJo lines up his rapid-fire quiz for the glamorous #StudentsOfTheYear.

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor & Priyanka Chopra
videos.overview: While PeeCee talks about her big fat wedding, Karan rags her for not adding him to the guest list. With some stunning disclosures, Bebo gives PeeCee tough competition for the hamper.

videos.title: The Koffee Awards
videos.overview: After a fiery and fun season, it's time for the awards! Catch all the action as judges Kirron Kher, Malaika Arora, Vir Das, and Mallika Dua help KJo to pick the winners of Season 6 over some spicy conversations. Any guesses who will take home the Audi?

videos.title: Unseen Koffee Konfessions
videos.overview: From unseen Koffee confessions to undekha rapid-fire revelations, catch an amazing compilation of KJo's glamorous guests from Season 6 getting super candid on the couch.

videos.title: A Peek into Celeb Life
videos.overview: Catch your favourite celebs spilling the beans about the intricacies of relationships, family, and friendships with private access to the juiciest confessions.

videos.title: Alia - Ranveer
videos.overview: The season Premieres with our new dulhaniya Alia Bhatt and dynamic Ranveer Singh. The self-proclaimed 'sakhis' are here to spill the tea on their partners, proposals and more!

videos.title: Sara - Janhvi
videos.overview: From skinny-dipping to being stranded on a mountain, B-Town BFFs Janhvi Kapoor and Sara Ali Khan lay it all out on the couch with a side-order of 'cheese' that no one saw coming.

videos.title: Akshay - Samantha
videos.overview: What happens when Bollywood's Khiladi, aka Akshay Kumar, teams up with south megastar Samantha Prabhu? They sizzle on the couch, roast their host and burn up the dance floor!

videos.title: Vijay - Ananya
videos.overview: Vijay Deverakonda and Ananya Panday discuss their dating lives, his B'wood journey and who hung out with whom at KJo's b-day bash! The Liger co-stars dare to share it all on the couch.

videos.title: Aamir - Kareena
videos.overview: While Kareena Kapoor Khan ranks Aamir Khan's fashion sense, he takes the mickey out of Karan. Watch the superstars talk about their equation, stardom and their modern families.

videos.title: Arjun - Sonam
videos.overview: The cool cousins Sonam and Arjun Kapoor are here to bring the house down! With no filter in play, nothing is off-limits for them - hookups, trolls and an unknown film, Shiva No. 1!

videos.title: Vicky - Sidharth
videos.overview: The newlywed Vicky Kaushal and the most eligible bachelor in B-town Sidharth Malhotra return to the Koffee couch to discuss thirst traps, their successful movies and marriages.

videos.title: Shahid - Kiara
videos.overview: Kiara Advani and Shahid Kapoor discuss Kabir Singh, some rib-tickling anecdotes, their individual struggles before gaining stardom and Kiara's marriage.

videos.title: Tiger - Kriti
videos.overview: While KJo wants to set up Kriti Sanon with a young actor who is not Tiger Shroff, Tiger admits to giving in to a co-star's advances. They discuss work, life and everything in between.

videos.title: Katrina, Ishaan and Siddhant
videos.overview: Katrina talks about her big wedding with Vicky and the drones that may or may not have been shot down! While Siddhant swears that he's single, Ishaan opens up about his ex-factor.

videos.title: Anil - Varun
videos.overview: Varun Dhawan and Anil Kapoor get candid about marriage, role-playing and more. The koffee is joined by cutting chai in a crazy coup as the boys dial up the heat on and off the floor.

videos.title: Gauri, Maheep and Bhavana
videos.overview: After 18 years, Gauri Khan returns for an unfiltered chat with her BFFs Bhavana Pandey and Maheep Kapoor to spill the tea on friendships, rivalries, vacays and their fabulous lives!

videos.title: The Koffee Awards
videos.overview: The final Koffee brews with Tanmay Bhat, Kusha Kapila, Danish Sait and Niharika NM dishing out the awards for this season. Tune in for sizzling conversations and steamy roasts.

videos.title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh
videos.overview: Karan is back with a banger of a season opener! Deepika and Ranveer reveal the inner workings of their relationship and how two main leads make one solid Bollywood couple.

videos.title: Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol
videos.overview: Legacy brothers Sunny and Bobby are here to slay! Watch them talk about Gadar's mega success, the Lord Bobby phenomenon and more, before Karan quizzes them about Papa Deol's films!

videos.title: Sara Ali Khan and Ananya Pandey
videos.overview: B-Town's newest besties Sara Ali Khan and Ananya Panday disclose the ABCs of their personal and professional lives before they wreck it up and be all "coy."

videos.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Alia Bhatt
videos.overview: The two sisters-in-law pass the vibe check as they spill the deets on their illustrious careers, legacy friendships and motherhood… while they accuse Karan of being a bot!

videos.title: Sidharth Malhotra and Varun Dhawan
videos.overview: Karan's "ex-students" reunite and bring the house down with their energy, camaraderie and personal anecdotes before they battle it out in a dynamic round against time.

videos.title: Kajol and Rani Mukerji
videos.overview: It's an unfiltered hang with the superstar cousins as they go wild with their stories from the sets of Kuch Kuch Hota Hai. It gets raving mad when the quiz leaves everyone in splits!

videos.title: Vicky Kaushal and Kiara Advani
videos.overview: What happens when B-Town’s favourite hit machines share the couch? Their fairytale proposal stories, career and marriage insights, and a dance battle will have you grooving!

videos.title: Aditya Roy Kapur and Arjun Kapoor
videos.overview: It’s Kapoor versus Kapur! The broody bachelors open up about their dating lives and professional journeys before dropping some truth bombs aka koffee shots on the couch.

videos.overview: From decades-old tales of friendships to stories from the good old days of retro Bollywood, Ajay and Rohit get real with insider trivia that will make your head go Golmaal.

videos.overview: It's a Pataudi fest on the couch. From mother-son banter to Saif’s adolescent quirks and Sharmila-ji's parenting tales, no story is off-limits.

videos.overview: B’Town’s slayest sisters give us a peek into the lives of “Kapoors, the Criminals” and spill all the tea on who they are “just friends” with before RAT-ting each other out to Karan!

videos.title: Zeenat Aman and Neetu Kapoor
videos.overview: These timeless icons brew a nostalgic blend of tantalising tales and amusing anecdotes as they give us a little glimpse into the Golden Age of Bollywood.
